Amazing breakfast in Hanoi!!!
Sep 2026 • Couples
Very highly recommended! We stayed 4 nights in the Golden Silk Hotel and got the package with breakfast included. So glad we did because everything was amazing. The food, the friendly staff, the view, the eating area. The value from the buffet style was great. The location so near the Old Quarter is good. Thang Duy was very kind and helpful. Also the one making the omelette to order was very good. When he had time to make the presentation of the food, he went over the top to make it look like a 5 star restaurant serving.
